Server message vectors (spec MSG family), shared across Langsys SDKs. AUTHORED in langsys-js-typescript, the owner named by the spec; other lanes vendor this file by blob and never edit their copy.

how_to_row_against_it.canonical_entries: Real framework messages, each naming the framework, its version and the sentence it comes from. template is that sentence unfilled with the field's label written in (MSG-3); message is the framework's own rendered text, and fill(template, params ?? {}) must reproduce it (MSG-4). field and code are the framework's own, passed through unchanged (MSG-1, MSG-2); framework and source are this file's annotations, not wire pieces.
how_to_row_against_it.markers: templateMarkers(template) must equal expected: marker names once each, in first-appearance order. A marker matches /\{([a-z][a-z0-9_]*)\}/.
how_to_row_against_it.fill: fill(template, params) must equal expected. A marker with no param, a null param, or a structure stays as its literal marker.
how_to_row_against_it.resolve: Resolving entries from body through options (key: the dotted path the server attached them under; pieces: the entries' piece names) must yield exactly expected, in order, in the SDK's piece names. body_unchanged: resolving never changes the body. An entry needs a string template or a string message.
how_to_row_against_it.render: With catalog published for locale (null means no catalog at all), rendering entry under category must yield expected: t(entry.template, category, entry.params ?? {}) when the catalog holds a translation for the template in that category, else entry.message. An entry with no template is not looked up and shows its message. entry.message is never a lookup key.
